metadata.title: Qwen27 Ascend full mechanism map · integrated preview
metadata.validity: Preview only. 78-wave ablation and four cache cohorts are integrated; strict output-ID equivalence did not pass, GDN state-restoration correctness is not established, overall quality remains unresolved, and CPU lifecycle 41-wave integration is complete; full native export/bundle remains open. Native export shard integrity and manifest membership are reviewable; root acceptance, quality equivalence, adoption, device critical path, and layer/flow binding remain unresolved.
metadata.subtitle: Accepted baseline + historical source/design snapshots + completed 78-wave ablation, four cache cohorts and standalone HCCL calibration. Host-mirror stall remains rejected with no finite performance result.
metadata.quality_scope: Long passkey semantic smoke only; not a complete quality benchmark. Current ablation quality equivalence remains unresolved.
metadata.environment: aarch64 / 单机8×Ascend910B1；vLLM0.30rc2 TP4 vs最后可用910B daily SGLang0.5.21.dev476 TP4+已验证正确性修复/FIA。BF16 activation+SSM，prefix/spec off，8192预算参考。两组CANN/torch-npu版本不同，结论仅适用于冻结部署组合。
metadata.core_generation_status: The supplied 78-wave ablation, cache cohort analysis and standalone HCCL calibration are complete. Strict output-ID equivalence did not pass; GDN state-restoration correctness is not established. CPU observer lifecycle is integrated for 41 eligible waves; native lineage and export integration remain open. Do not treat this preview as final.

causal_findings.finding: GDN decode状态布局错误：原optimized kernel按[K,V]寻址，而pool/native chunk/generic使用[V,K]。K=V=128使shape检查无法发现。

causal_findings.finding: FIA与mixed的端到端链式消融已完成，最后两配置接近，不能用单波约2%差异宣布mixed优劣。
causal_findings.evidence_level: 同131072/C5/out1024的四个关闭波次；固定顺序各1波

causal_findings.evidence_level: 两关闭窗口各4rank原始communication/kernel审计
causal_findings.scope: native/FIA每窗口1040个rank-local事件；每rank258AllReduce+2AllGather。4个Total Op Info均与所属事件和一致并排除，raw镜像不重复解析；SG本窗口只有具名hcom260条/rank，无AivKernel双表示。HCCS/SDMA相等视图不相加。

consequences: Do not treat hook installation or the existence of a method definition as proof of execution.
Instrument backend.capture_one with explicit shape key and distinguish its two warmups from the recorded capture.
Existing CPU replay begin and request performance observations are independent of this unused capture hook.
Capture/startup costs are excluded from primary warmed N3 performance scoring.

gen32_multibucket_observation.graph_context_binding: backend._graphs[exact shape_key] object ID -> unique PID/rank/object capture receipt -> allowed Model ID -> physical-to-model stream -> exact Model/Stream/Task

actual_model_capture_endpoints.scope: Actual TP4 bucket1 model canary: exact endpoints, not full-layer task membership, native timing, replay-instance closure or performance claim.

formulas.native_extra_residual_s: ΔnativeTTFT − Δqueue − Δprefill = Δ[(queued_ts − arrival_time) + (iteration_timestamp − core_first_token_ts)]

report.scope: Per-replicate per-request means. Native selected metric counts equal request counts in both arms. Signed values retained. Residuals are accounting remainders, not CPU/network/NPU attribution.

arrival_clock.finding: arrival_time is explicitly labeled engine frontend wall-clock; saved runtime InputProcessor fallbacks call time.time() at input_processor.py:311,322.

core_clock_fields.finding: queued_ts, scheduled_ts, first_token_ts, last_token_ts explicitly labeled engine-core monotonic.

scheduled_event_clock.finding: scheduled_timestamp=time.monotonic() and exact value passed to SCHEDULED record_event.

queued_event_origin.finding: record_event forwards optional timestamp into EngineCoreEvent.new_event; that factory is absent from captured frozen slice. stats.py explicitly labels queued_ts as engine-core monotonic.

engine_core_timestamp_flow.finding: outputs.timestamp is passed unchanged to process_outputs; engine_core_timestamp is assigned unchanged to first_token_ts. Stats source comment classifies first_token_ts as engine-core monotonic. Producer assignment of outputs.timestamp is absent from captured runtime-source-vllm slice, so installed producer version binding remains incomplete.

clock_domain_correction.gen4_identity: ΔnativeTTFT−ΔQ−ΔP is an exact numerical accounting identity for the matched saved aggregates.
clock_domain_correction.reason: Each term crosses the explicitly documented wall/monotonic domains. Their algebraic sum is the remainder; interpreting either cross-domain term separately as elapsed duration requires a wall-to-monotonic offset bridge and stability assumptions across compared runs.
clock_domain_correction.allowed_interpretation: Keep native/client residual values and exact closure. Treat the cross-clock expansion as symbolic algebra only; do not assign individual terms to CPU, network, NPU, or another cause.

canary_bridge.method: mono_ns−round(engine_core_timestamp_s×1e9); avoids wall-clock conversion and numerically agrees with gen4 same-row wall−mono bridge.
canary_bridge.precision_and_scope: Probe reads time.time_ns() then time.monotonic_ns() sequentially in one hook. The engine timestamp is a float in seconds (about 0.93 ns ULP at this magnitude); conversion/float quantization is sub-ns scale, but row does not record call separation or provide a calibrated uncertainty bound. 854274 ns is therefore an observed difference, not a metrologically bounded latency. Source comments label first_token_ts engine-core monotonic, but captured excerpt does not bind timestamp producer code to installed process or establish cross-rank behavior.
canary_bridge.claim_boundary: Single canary timing only; not TTFT remainder and not evidence for budget-ablation causality.

version_binding.result: All three core.py snapshots have identical SHA; runtime-source-vllm has no core.py. Process observation found vLLM running in a Docker container, but exact installed producer file was not captured in this bounded audit. This proves local frozen snapshot semantics/flow, not bit-for-bit installed producer identity.

definitions.finding: EngineCoreEvent.new_event default timestamp uses time.monotonic(); explicit supplied timestamp is preserved.
EngineCoreOutputs.__post_init__ sets time.monotonic() when timestamp is zero/default.

report.supersedes_gap: cpu-sg-recovery/gen5/source_receipt.json version_binding installed producer source missing: now captured exact container files. Historical gen5 report is unchanged.
limits: Read-only snapshot collected after saved waves, not a per-event branch trace.
Default clock producer definitions do not calibrate cross-process/cross-rank NPU clocks.
Gen4 native/client duration residuals remain valid; cross wall/monotonic expansion terms are not separately elapsed intervals.
Single hook wall/mono sampling is sequential; no calibrated uncertainty bound.

budget_boundary_accounting.interpretation: Exact differences of per-request mean duration metrics. The expanded vLLM queued-arrival and iteration-core terms cross wall/monotonic domains and are not individually elapsed durations. Residuals are not CPU/network/NPU attribution; the separate single-canary observed difference has no calibrated uncertainty bound.

raw_key_coverage.coverage_semantics: Copied exactly from saved inventory report; row-key match coverage is not a layer/replay assignment.

duration_summary.arithmetic_check: notification_control + non_control_native duration sums equal selected_model_duration_sum_ns; all totals retain overlapping event durations and are not wall-clock time.

unknown_operator_summary.meaning: Rows whose source operator_name is absent; kept separate and not dropped.

limits: Notification/capture/event/control task types are retained as notification_control, not compute. Other native tasks are labeled non_control_native, not presumed to be compute (for example DMA/data movement remains included).
All duration sums are overlap-retaining cumulative native event time, not exclusive device time, request latency, or wall-clock time.
Database globalPid and device are retained as grouping keys; no PIDs or ranks are merged.
This is a whole-wave inventory only: no layer, phase, replay, or completion attribution.

identity.database_global_pid_domain: TASK.globalPid is retained separately; it is not equated to trace_view process PID

definitions.output_tps: sum output tokens / first request start to last EOF
definitions.endpoint_tpot: per request (EOF-first nonempty text)/(1024-1), then arithmetic request mean. Includes interference/front-end; not pure token kernel rate.
definitions.ttft: client request dispatch to first nonempty text. Input is frozen token IDs; tokenizer excluded.
definitions.native_metrics: Never sum duplicate TP-rank histogram views or treat lifecycle spans as exclusive machine wall time.

document.scope: 自研推理引擎的实现路线；依据本机已测 Qwen27 与冻结源码。设计建议不是已实现的收益。后续实测结果以完整报告覆盖。
document.baseline_architecture: aarch64 / 8xAscend910B1；每框架TP4；dense hybrid 48 GDN +16 full-attention；W8A8_DYNAMIC，BF16 activation/SSM；无MoE/无投机。
measurement_rules: TTFT 从客户端发起到首个非空文本；token-ID矩阵不含tokenizer。端点TPOT=(EOF-first_text)/(output_tokens-1)，并非逐token设备执行时间。
整批TPS含排队和prompt处理；与固定活跃并发下的纯decode吞吐分列。
跨框架CANN版本和卡组不同，比较的是冻结部署组合；同框架单变量消融才能缩小机制归因范围。
模型原基线的greedy重复也可能不一致。区分协议/长度/局部passkey/输出等价，不把性能观察自动变为可合入结论。

implementation_roadmap.implement: 在调度器与设备后端之间定义不可变step描述：request IDs、phase、scheduled/actual/padded rows、context长度、graph key、state/KV版本、采样/提交token计数。把CPU span、ACL connection、Model/Stream/Task和SSE frame IDs贯通。
implementation_roadmap.borrow: 两框架现有请求生命周期与图元数据；本次严格关联probe与CANN exporter source binding。
implementation_roadmap.measured_basis: 旧output32校准：v32 forwards/32 samples；SG33 forwards/32提交token。500窗口通信130620 rank-events严格匹配32655四rank collective；CANN9存在Transit=0但链路时长>0。
implementation_roadmap.acceptance: 所有归因展示覆盖/歧义/未关联数；CPU/NPU时间分开；不同rank和重复通信视图不能相加为机器墙钟。源码、版本、shape、dtype与负载指纹随结果保存。
implementation_roadmap.risk_or_limit: NPUGraph debug_dump 的ts/dur是拓扑占位值。它只用于task身份和权重指针归属；实际耗时来自native trace。

implementation_roadmap.implement: 按prefill/mixed/decode、Q长度和历史长度显式选kernel；为混合GDN/full-attention提供正确的state布局、ModelSlim packed-loader语义与fallback。
implementation_roadmap.borrow: SGLang GDN decode融合；vLLM/Ascend按混合batch拆attention query的实现；统一后端能力表。
implementation_roadmap.measured_basis: 旧本机诊断中，SG native mixed路径的decode query padding随历史放大；开启FIA后128K/C5单波显著缩短，但该修复链不是N3消融。SG两步GDN decode为96次融合事件，而v为384次；对应局部累计3.477ms与5.146ms。
implementation_roadmap.acceptance: 共享operand、真实dtype/state layout验证通过，再比较相同shape耗时；不能从算子事件数直接推导整批收益。
implementation_roadmap.risk_or_limit: GDN prefill共享operand微测T8192约1.796ms(v)/1.819ms(SG)，不足解释服务中全部GDN差额。跨CANN/card-group仍有混杂。

implementation_roadmap.implement: 依据实际活跃batch分布与padding成本捕获档位，记录graph key/replay频率及额外显存。分离目标图、prefill图和动态metadata更新。
implementation_roadmap.borrow: 两框架已有decode graph bucket机制，增加真实常见C5/C10档位；不把power-of-two当固定最优。
implementation_roadmap.measured_basis: 本次N3短输入C5/C10，加入5/10图档后paired整批TPS约+4.90%至+5.88%，端点TPOT约-4.75%至-5.67%；vC10 TTFT约+11.44%。
implementation_roadmap.acceptance: 实测actual/padded rows、成功capture和实际replay，而非仅检查启动参数。收益与TTFT、图内存、cache容量一并评估。
implementation_roadmap.risk_or_limit: 目前core实验输出等价未建立，不能直接合入。减少padding行的比例不是端到端延迟下降比例。

implementation_roadmap.implement: 以预测的step毫秒预算调配decode与prefill，而不是只依据固定token数；同时考虑队列年龄、context长度、16层full-attention和48层GDN的不同成本。保留可复算的chunk分配记录。
implementation_roadmap.borrow: vLLM统一token budget与SGLang PrefillAdder/mixed；DeepInfer文档的time-quota思想仅作设计参考。
implementation_roadmap.measured_basis: Qwen本次8192→16384的N3结果没有整批TPS收益；32K/C10 paired TTFT v+6.849%、SG+7.633%，TPOT端点估算分别-1.847%/-0.177%。v E2E增加约0.56秒，首文本却晚约1.3–1.5秒，端点窗口被压缩。
implementation_roadmap.acceptance: 用实际scheduled chunks、prefill/mixed/decode步与队列生命周期残差检验机制；以TTFT/TPOT SLO下最大可持续TPS为目标。
implementation_roadmap.risk_or_limit: Q+P生命周期不是纯设备prefill计算。端点TPOT变小本身不证明decode kernel更快；该Qwen结果不外推DeepSeek R220。

implementation_roadmap.implement: 重叠host metadata、采样/CPU输出与下一步设备执行，明确stream/event生产和消费关系、取消与尾token提交；以状态版本消除隐式同步依赖。
implementation_roadmap.borrow: vLLM AsyncScheduler、SGLang overlap schedule、DeepInfer异步流水线的职责划分。
implementation_roadmap.measured_basis: 独立async-on/off N3、四场景请求输入/seed/body/max_tokens逐条一致：关闭异步后，512/C16整批TPS的paired变化为v−24.392%、SG−12.494%，端点TPOT+34.376%/+14.922%；131072/C5 TPS−7.223%/−3.609%、端点TPOT+13.200%/+6.077%。这是同框架冻结组合的描述性性能机制观察，非输出等价或可合入结论。旧SG校准有一轮未提交额外forward。CPU mirror候选虽4rank×512长度一致，长输入trial501.3357秒无响应，栈在NPUEvent同步等待，已拒绝。 两场景中关异步后SG整批TPS均高于v，而异步ON均由v领先：512/C16 OFF约507.35(SG)/474.71(v)，ON579.82/628.07；131072/C5 OFF42.49/41.61，ON44.07/44.84。说明不能仅凭某个更快局部kernel解释整栈排名；跨框架仍受CANN/card-group混杂，未将全部差额归因于异步机制。
implementation_roadmap.acceptance: 同时统计额外计算query、输出提交、host enqueue gap和设备区间；不同batch大小、长短输入切换及EOF后均无挂起。
implementation_roadmap.risk_or_limit: 禁止仅因某个D2H昂贵就删除它：它可能同时承担执行次序约束。本次确切event producer/order缺陷尚未证明。

implementation_roadmap.implement: 分别管理paged attention KV与GDN递归state；prefix checkpoint带版本/长度/slot，采用显式COW与提交规则。按工作量决定缓存checkpoint密度。
implementation_roadmap.borrow: vLLM hybrid KV manager和align；SGLang UnifiedRadix/Mamba COW；Niko1221/Strata的hybrid消息边界checkpoint设计。
implementation_roadmap.measured_basis: 共享16K prefix+512 suffix、输出1024、C5/10、每场景N3，cache OFF/ON逐请求prompt/body/seed/max_tokens一致。TTFT为请求中位数再跨rep取中位：v C5 5.773→1.036s、C10 9.895→1.290s；SG C5 6.043→0.672s、C10 10.256→0.945s。整批TPS v163.54→219.33 /234.09→379.53，SG151.12→196.17 /220.20→338.23。所有passkey/协议/计数通过，但strictID基线与candidate重复均不稳，四组质量等价未定，仅列诊断性能观察。状态restore/COW设备轨迹仍需另查；cached_tokens不构成状态正确证明。
implementation_roadmap.acceptance: 同时核对prefix命中、state恢复/拷贝调用、实际device copy/复用路径、输出检查与cache容量变化；冷独立prompt和热共享prefix分别测试。
implementation_roadmap.risk_or_limit: SG extra_buffer会改变state池容量与KV空间；不能把它视为无成本开关。cache索引在设备上时保留unknown，不强制D2H污染测量。

implementation_roadmap.implement: 将host/storage布局与计算布局解耦，调度异步KV预取与命中等待；在计算前显式等待数据ready事件，保证evict/cancel/drain正确。
implementation_roadmap.borrow: OSDI26 Strata的GPU辅助I/O、layout解耦及cache-aware scheduling；与Niko1221/Strata项目分别标注。
implementation_roadmap.measured_basis: 这些机制仅有冻结公开源码/论文证据，尚无本机910B实施或收益。当前冷唯一prompt矩阵不代表热KV I/O负载。
implementation_roadmap.acceptance: 热prefix、多轮对话、容量压力、IO带宽/尾延迟与eviction正确性形成独立对照；Ascend侧必须有可用的DMA/内存注册后端。
implementation_roadmap.risk_or_limit: 论文GPU/主机配置的吞吐倍数不能当作910B预测；Niko Strata的MoE专家offload不适用于当前dense模型。

implementation_roadmap.implement: 仅在模型具有适配的draft/验证接口时引入自适应候选长度；成本函数同时考虑接受率、target padded rows、draft周期和KV回滚。MoE专家缓存作为另一个可选后端。
implementation_roadmap.borrow: DeepInfer confidence+hardware-cost验证长度与异步接口；Niko1221/Strata的专家cache仅供未来MoE。
implementation_roadmap.measured_basis: 当前Qwen部署没有投机或MoE；DeepInfer冻结版本仅声明SM100/Ascend950、DeepSeekV4.1，不能在910B/Qwen上声称已有收益。
implementation_roadmap.acceptance: 先实现正确的draft/target token与state提交/回滚，再按负载扫长度、记录每位置接受率和周期成本，用同输出质量门槛验证端到端指标。
implementation_roadmap.risk_or_limit: DeepInfer bounded-SWA replay涉及模型特定或近似语义；YOCO也有结构前提，不能作为通用精确KV替代直接启用。

logical_state_size_example.status: model-configuration-derived logical bytes; not measured allocation or promised savings
logical_state_size_example.assumptions: GDN BF16 state per rank [12,128,128] for each of48layers, TP4; ignores convolution state, padding, allocator/copy buffers and cache metadata
logical_state_size_example.interpretation: 扩大可缓存递归state数量会占用HBM并可能减少attention KV容量；必须核对实际池shape与dtype。

optimization_scope_taxonomy.mechanism: 异步调度、提交/取消与stream-event协议
optimization_scope_taxonomy.portability: 推理框架机制；需要后端实现相同依赖/状态提交契约
optimization_scope_taxonomy.dependency: 不依赖特定权重数值；收益随host/device比例与负载变
optimization_scope_taxonomy.adoption: 本机开关N3有性能证据；正式实现需数值/尾请求/取消等价验收

optimization_scope_taxonomy.portability: 跨模型的框架机制；图安全性/可捕获算子依赖模型后端
optimization_scope_taxonomy.dependency: 按实际batch分布选档；5/10不是通用默认
optimization_scope_taxonomy.adoption: 当前denseQwen短输入约5%吞吐观察，TTFT代价及质量边界单列

optimization_scope_taxonomy.dependency: 最优chunk随attention/SSM成本、上下文、并发和SLO变化
optimization_scope_taxonomy.adoption: 本机16K预算未带来TPS收益；不能固化为优化默认

optimization_scope_taxonomy.dependency: 依赖算子/shape/dtype/layout契约；不是修改权重数值
optimization_scope_taxonomy.adoption: 能复用到相同架构及后端能力的模型，迁移需共享operand数值与负载验证

optimization_scope_taxonomy.portability: KV+递归state模型架构的状态管理机制
optimization_scope_taxonomy.dependency: prefix相同且checkpoint/state版本有效；收益依赖真实复用率
optimization_scope_taxonomy.adoption: 有共享16K热prefix诊断N3改善，当前严格等价未通过；不是冷唯一prompt收益

optimization_scope_taxonomy.portability: 量化格式与模型张量命名/拼接契约
optimization_scope_taxonomy.dependency: 换量化格式或packed mapping需重新适配
optimization_scope_taxonomy.adoption: 正确性兼容修复，不作独立速度收益

optimization_scope_taxonomy.portability: 框架可抽象，收益依赖target/drafter组合与接受率
optimization_scope_taxonomy.dependency: 当前Qwen无draft/无投机；DeepInfer公开支持限950/SM100及DeepSeekV4.1
optimization_scope_taxonomy.adoption: 本机Qwen未验证，作为后续可选模块而非已测功能
当前不适用；Strata专家缓存数字不移植到此模型

association_notes: All observer linkage uses exact request ID or explicitly supplied alias map.

CPU token readiness is IPC send begin (SGLang) or explicit token_ready (vLLM); scheduler_commit is postprocess_end only.

stages.report_text:
# Q27 gen8 阶段结果：请求身份补证

状态：阶段完成，standalone executor 验证，待 root 验收；整体未完成，未发布、未采用优化。

本轮仅做只读源码/证据提取和本地 CPU 分析，没有启动模型、服务或 NPU 作业，也未借 SDK slot、终止外部作业或释放卡组。

## 可核验进展

- 客户端 manifest 的完整请求 ID 与 API header observer 相等；API entry step_id 与所有 SSE observer 的 api_call_id 精确关联。
- 从冻结 commit `ced6857afa0ea7b2e3f0846a62e1394e90f15607` 的真实 AST 执行完整 `request_id` / `request_id_item` 赋值规则，结果与已观察到的 SSE response ID、frontend ID 全值相等。**API→frontend 是源码规则佐证，不冒充同记录直接观测。** 两份补取基类与该 commit 的 git blob 完全一致；另外四份安装源码与已有冻结文件完全一致。
- 32 条 `token_ready_enter` 每条同时保存 engine ID 与 frontend ID，并有32条一致的 exit；与 enqueue、已有124回放的完整 engine ID相等。该结果独立保存于 `request-identity-audit-v2.json`；原 gen6/gen7 输入不变。
- 客户端 wire 34帧（33 JSON + DONE），完整 response ID一致；CPU output_processing 32次各报告1个新 token。**不按帧/调用顺序建立逐 token因果关系。** worker-step→输出token、SSE-frame→输出token仍unknown。
- 11个CPU fixture通过，包括错误api_call_id/PID、仅前缀相似、缺失/歧义双ID、重复frontend identity、错误结束状态等拒绝路径。
- 新 `map-preview/index.html` 显式加入请求身份表与证据类型，保留原7936层区间、124个vLLM回放和历史gen64缺口；冻结 baseline/mechanisms/design语义SHA不变。Chromium file:// QA验证4身份节点、124回放/7936行、128个SG选项、15source links、8FX sidecars、41CPU shards，无JS/console错误和网络请求。桌面/移动截图已查看；该QA只适用于本派生预览，非final204。

## 证据与范围

- `request-identity-audit-v2.json`：身份、edge类型、原始observer event index、输入SHA、部署范围与限制。
- `request-evidence/download.json` / `wire-download.json`：task-private remote读取后逐文件SHA验证；未包含transport或凭据。
- `installed-base-source-commit.json`：两份新增基类精确commit-byte核对。
- `map-preview/gen8-build-receipt.json` / `browser-QA.json`：实际产物SHA、保留语义SHA与浏览器检查。
- `q27-gen8-portable-review.tar.gz` / `package-receipt.json`：allowlist审阅包，成员重新读回核对，无transport/key/原生profiles。
- `remote-observation.json` / `external-jobs-receipt.json`：当前外部作业精确PID、start_ticks、command、host boot ID、日志与终止条件。

范围沿用已冻结gen81诊断：EXPERIMENT_HOST、aarch64、910B1、vLLM/CANN9.2、TP4、bucket1、512/C1/output32，带插桩短诊断。不能外推为未插桩矩阵时间；四rank不相加为墙钟；端点不等于独占kernel或全stream关键路径；跨CANN/卡组比较不是纯框架因果。

## 失败与差异

首次读取基类时误用旧目录 `openai/engine/serving.py`，文件不存在，未作修改；依据冻结completion import定位到真实generate/base与serve/engine路径后读取成功。属于证据提取路径错误，不是技术方案失败。

本地所有权核对发现Codex当前argv hash与driver记录的启动argv hash不同；runner精确PID/start/argv匹配，Codex精确start_ticks及直接父runner匹配，worker flock仍有唯一持有者，另一路径锁未占用。差异原样保存在 `local-owner-observation.json`；不据此声称独立核实了服务端模型身份。未发现第二资源写者，也未抢锁。

## 接续

原native204 pipeline仍运行，全部下游仍等待。下一轮先核对精确现场身份并读取最新状态，不重跑基线/消融/gen81；若未204完成，可独立完成现有证据的机制/源码/优化候选覆盖审查或发布材料校验。若204就绪，核对完整input/export/audit/archive gate，再将gen8 overlay/template/guide显式应用到实际final204资产、重新打包SHA并对该实际产物做浏览器QA。worker-step/token因果边若无新显式证据保持unknown，不为追求闭合重新采集同因诊断。

质量/greedy等价、优化采用、原gen64缺口、profiler RECORD-stop警告、final204 QA、私有main/index归档与root最终接受均保留待办。发布前刷新AGENTS/README/R_TEMPLATE/分支头/leafsys1权限；未分配R、未发布。

hypothesis.intervention: For the narrow supported single-request decode tail, process the one pending result before invoking get_next_batch_to_run, rather than launching another forward first.
hypothesis.mechanism: Actual final token/finish handler drains and retires request before prepare_for_decode allocates the next KV slot or advances recurrent-state bookkeeping.
hypothesis.observable: Same actual token IDs/finish reason/SSE and cleanup; one fewer forward/preparation for max-length C1 cap>=2; no change to ordinary interior overlap.

Drain does not finish through original handler

budget.C: len(req.output_ids), after actual prior result handling
budget.Pmin: Guaranteed number of output tokens represented by the exact same-request not-yet-processed result, under no-spec/no-mask admitted contract; 1 in narrow candidate
budget.Pmax: Upper bound alone is insufficient; uncertain 0..K outcomes must fall back
budget.gate: 0 <= C < L, exactly one pending decode result, exact RID+slot+generation identity, all narrow scope contracts true, C+Pmin >= L
forbidden_substitutes: sum of pending query rows or spec draft width (not a lower bound on accepted tokens)
request list position / task order / time proximity (not identity)

implementation_design.seam: event_loop_overlap after ingest/pause check, before get_next_batch_to_run
actions: Read immutable narrow proof facts without device synchronization or planner mutation.
If eligible, consume existing FIFO result once through original process_batch_result (waits copy_done and handles output/finish/cache/state).
Mark previous result consumed; for decode-only narrow seam last_batch=None prevents later double pop. Do not invent or append tokens, set finished_reason, free pools, or clear FutureMap directly.
Call original planner with finished Req still owned by its normal bookkeeping until original filter; no manually deleting rows or undoing a prepared batch.
Preserve original interior overlap and WAR/copy/sample/relay lifetime; all ineligible cases execute original sequence.
implementation_design.scope: Initially one request, one decode result, non-spec, no grammar/mask/cancel/retract/chunk/mixed/beam/DP/PP/disagg/other pending admissions; no hidden-state/logprob auxiliary contract changes.
implementation_design.source_semantics: kv_committed_len is scheduler-side KV accounting, not evidence a device task completed or an output token was committed.
implementation_design.state_contract_status: UNKNOWN for current hybrid 48 GDN +16 FA model. Source permits Mamba result lookahead 0 or1 but that does not prove device/state-cache reuse safety. No live patch.

ownership_obligations: Do not release the request or KV/GDN state based on budget prediction. Original result handling remains sole output/finish/release owner.
Before slot reuse require all pending reads/writes and copy/sampling/relay work for old RID+slot+allocation-generation fenced; slot reuse must not read stale FutureMap payload.
Validate owned KV length and cache insertion at actual consumed-token length, which may be one shorter without overshoot; never rewrite lengths to mimic old extra work.
Mamba/GDN running state, ping-pong snapshots, masks, decode_batch_idx and result snapshots must all refer to the completed forward; require exact target-model boundary/reuse canaries.
TP ranks agree on the drain/next-forward decision and resulting collectives. A device-layer endpoint is not sufficient for lifecycle proof.

八个零增量都在处理前已经 finished、pool slot/generation 已释放，且 preplan 不再满足完整 allocation identity。不能填回释放后的 slot/generation。八个预算模式分别是每 rank 的 launch8（7→8）和 launch41（31→32）；另有 launch9/42 处理 finished 请求而不增加输出。这些是观察器自己的显式 launch，不冒充原 native step，也不将两个 engine RID 按数量/时间归给外部 API 请求。这里只证明 host 列表长度变化，不证明具体 token ID、step→token 设备因果或去掉 forward 后的输出等价。

冻结源码给出一个更窄的条件结论：成功进入并完成普通非 spec decode 处理器、存在对应 token row、不走 beam/finished/retracted skip、无 sampling-mask abort 时，`_normalize_decode_outputs` 把该行单个 ID 包为长度1的列表；处理器先 extend 输出，再调用 finish-state 方法。因此该条件路径接纳数为1。EOS/length 的结束判断位于 extend 之后，不能把未知 EOS 值当成零接纳的理由。但采样掩码拒绝分支明确令 `new_accept_len=0`，而 stash 返回一次并不排除它。

执行了冻结的完整 `process_batch_result_decode` 与 `_normalize_decode_outputs` AST，共128个 CPU stub 分支组合。finish/cache/stream/device/relay/spec resolution 是明确 stub；没有导入 torch 或服务。普通路径与 mask-abort 路径可以具有相同的 gen16 已记录标量投影，而主机输出列表实际增量分别为1和0。这是构造的源码反例，未观测到真实 mask abort 或部署错误。另7个输入破坏用例验证审计器拒绝错 result、错 launch、错 RID/进程、虚构 post-free generation、丢记录及篡改 pending 副本。

所以 gen16 不能提供规划前可用的正下界。缺少的事实包括实际处理器 class/function/source 的加载绑定、batch mode/spec、token-row coverage、beam/retracted/mask 分支及其在处理前的不变性。gen16 四份 loader 回执绑定了 scheduler 源码；没有为 batch-result processor 单独留下加载 SHA。本轮只验证它的冻结 manifest 和先前文件来源，不把文件存在升级成实际执行绑定。`pending_token_lower_bound` 仍 unknown，所有决策 fallback。copy 完成、GDN/cache 内容与引用生命周期、slot 复用、干预后的 TP 一致性、精确输出/greedy 等价也仍未知。事后观察增加1不能填充这些证明义务。

本补充尚未写入 gen9 预览或实际204地图；需和 gen8–16 一起显式 overlay/repackage/browser QA。未分配 R，未发布，未标记优化采用或整体完成。源码范围、全文件/摘录 SHA、每个真实结果调用的计数、CPU反例与失败记录都在本代独立目录，证据包不含 transport/key。

本代闭合原HCCL独立微测的原输出、采集包络、部署绑定及历史端口失败，没有重跑性能矩阵、消融、模型、服务、NPU或SDK。仅使用任务private transport读取29份小文件并逐项SHA/bytes核对。新进程仅为已结束的CPU读取/分析，没有外部后台任务。启动argv安全字段核对为gpt-6.1-sol/high；实际服务端模型身份未暴露。

两套既有容器各四rank，7个BF16 AllReduce形状和2个FP32 AllGather形状，共72个rank/case。独立核算7200个eager事件、280个graph replay事件的形状/正确性/摘要/20调用摊销。所有72行原逐rank中位数与此前comparison精确相同；AllGather无graph。每case每rank的graph只有5个回放事件，各包含20个collectives，不是100个独立graph样本。没有把rank求和为墙钟、没有抹去等待或换成物理带宽。

原采集时钟：vLLM 2026-10-25T13:42:12.590872578Z至13:42:37.496756796Z；SG 13:42:37.714258735Z至13:43:17.829576305Z。这是controller保存的docker-exec启动到退出包络，非逐设备collective绝对时钟、非模型请求/EOF时间，不用mtime或事件耗时倒推。容器/image与此前部署inventory、baseline-handover一致；ready时钟早于采集；显式OMP=1、HCCL端口auto、world4、图20调用及原55s预算绑定。先前同容器package/git证据按原download manifest重核，micro各worker实际动态库/全环境身份未保存，不能从旧inventory穷尽推定。

首次SHA门禁揭示8份remote rank原件比以前local副本各多一个末尾LF；全文件其余字节与parsed JSON完全相等。原local SHA仍匹配旧comparison，remote原件另保存完整SHA；未改动任何原件。用原analyze_hccl.py（算法不变，仅AST重绑输入根）重算全部JSON，差别仅为这8个sources.sha256；按已证明字节桥归一化这8项后，完整JSON与既有comparison相等，任何数值未归一化。失败尝试和差异独立落盘，不能描述成原文件SHA全等或旧分析器raw bytes完全相等。

源码另揭示两个口径限制：controller的idle(k)前后调用写同一*-before.metrics，postcheck覆盖precheck；剩余gauges为0仅证明最后idle，不证明两份快照保留或连续idle。process_import_seconds_before_init的起点在imports之后，是相邻monotonic读数间隔，不能用于import成本。当前controller/standalone源码SHA无取数前freeze凭据，源码机制与原输出桥分别表达，不虚构历史执行文件SHA。

domains.report_text:
# 第25代：GDN原微测出处及测量范围（阶段完成，待root验收）

本代复核两套已部署底座的原GDN独立API微测，没有重跑矩阵、消融、模型、服务、NPU或SDK。启动安全参数核对为gpt-6.1-sol/high；实际服务端模型身份未暴露。19份小原件逐项SHA/bytes核对，7个pt远端全文件流式SHA复读，3个T128输入/输出小文件另下载并核对，原始二进制未入archive-draft或Git。

10个case共50个事件批次、1000次计时API调用，另50次预热。5个共享输入SHA与fixture-manifest、两臂fixture_sha256均闭合；原results与原stdout/旧本地JSON相等，20项均值/中位数独立核算。原controller明确v采集2026-10-25T09:33:03.412794002Z–09:33:15.145800380Z，SG09:33:15.147008088Z–09:33:32.240994309Z，均为docker-exec启动至退出包络，不是逐kernel或请求时钟。

脚本每臂只使用logical device0，并非TP4；可见卡组为原0–3与4–7，micro worker没有独立保存物理映射。随机共享CPU operands，固定Nk4/Nv12/Dk128/Dv128、qkv/state BF16、g FP32，不是模型激活。每批20次eager API调用取事件区间/20，仅5批/case，不作100独立样本，不是captured graph；无法仅靠event隔离host-feed、等待或分配成本。显式OMP4、PYTHONPATH runtime及python3 -P按原command核对；SG服务独有compat环境不能自动套到另一个docker-exec。源码一次前置零队列检查未保存metrics，也无后置或连续idle证据。

两臂T128保存输出文件全字节相同，历史FP32参考报告与原stdout/旧本地报告相等。原evaluator在本机x86_64、torch2.14.1+cpu单线程复读同一历史保存张量，pairwise字段相等，但against_reference的12个描述性指标未与原aarch64报告完全相等；最大指标字段绝对差1.2900659274346638e-08。严格全JSON回归首次拒绝后，保留双方报告及差异，不归一化、不设临时容差、不当作技术候选失败。差异机制未实证归因，不用本机结论替代aarch64，参考指标本来无接受阈值。其余4case每臂仅有末次finite/shape，没有已保存成对/参考输出；[4096,4096]参数语义、initial_state不变性等未独立验收。模型输出/greedy等价仍unknown。

新UNALLOCATED archive-draft新增4份小CSV（采集/部署/逐case/配对摘要），旧15份字节不变，共19份均小于64KB。24文件SHA、290表格行、45内部链接、16 RESULT字段、10case原值与5项描述性ratio检查通过；不是全repoCI或性能验收。没有分配R、commit/push或发布。当前源码SHA不是取数前freeze，micro worker模块与CANN动态库全身份没有收据，CANN/依赖/固定卡组混杂保留。未推导纯框架因果、模型收益或优化采用。

只观察原204一次：parent ranks列表报告111 verified_archived，但同快照pipeline_counts为submitted110/inflight4/pending90。这是记录字段瞬时不一致，未把差值补齐、未当204完成、未将submitted当completed；该快照不能给出冻结终态。四原master PID/start/command匹配；下游仍waiting。旧SDK确切PID不存在、自有container停、slot resumed。all8原逻辑归属保留，无新外部后台作业、无锁抢占/借slot/资源释放/终止。完整外部身份见external-jobs-receipt.json，未观察的旧作业明确保留旧时间；4CPUworker为原parent管理，本代不另探个体。

另一次草稿验证因局部变量遮蔽构建receipt而KeyError，已修正后通过；这是本代验证脚本问题，不是原数据或技术候选失败。

下一轮先观察204一次；完成则核对真实input/export/audit/archive全SHA，再gen19合并显式加入gen21–25及current supplements，对实际204做HTTP/browser QA。如果仍pending，可把gen21–25溯源接入新的独立地图预览与合并runbook，做浏览器QA，保留预览/最终204区别。Q06维持fallback，质量与因果未知不放宽；整体接受仍由root核验，overall_complete=false。临分号/发布刷新项目规则、远端heads、编号占用及leafsys1权限。

# vLLM 原生图端点诊断代码候选（未发布，待 root 验收）

这是实际 gen81 短诊断的任务自有代码子集与 CPU 审计入口。它给 64 层 pre/post 事件附唯一 JSON 标签，以同一 profile 的 raw `EVENT_RECORD` 标签取得 Model/Stream/Task，再使用显式 flow 关联回放边界。它是诊断插桩，未作为推理优化采用；设备端点区间不是独占 kernel 或全 stream 关键路径。四 rank 不相加为墙钟。

## 文件与字节依据

`runtime/` 是从历史部署清单递归选择的 13 个任务模块，根为 `q27_fx_model_bootstrap`。所有静态 Import/ImportFrom 的本任务模块依赖均包含，逐件 SHA 与 gen27 已绑定的实际 gen81 字节相等；动态 import 的框架插件由原冻结环境提供，此处不声称完整服务可复现。`source-bindings.json` 记录每件来源、SHA、角色及依赖图。

`historical-build/` 保存原 gen78 C++ 与原 CPU 构建脚本原字节。原脚本、bootstrap 的 `/task/...` 路径和模块名是历史事实；某些注释仍含 gen53 字样，不是当前模块名。原脚本不能在任意解压目录直接运行。`build_extension.py` 是本轮新增的路径可配置入口，保持原 C++、编译参数、链接库与精确模块初始化名；本轮未执行该入口编译或加载，不能称为已验证可移植构建。重建 SO 的 SHA 不假定等于历史 SO。

`raw-audit/` 保留标签到 raw 图的精确身份审计与反例；`executor-run-gen5/` 和 `native-sg-recovery/gen66/` 保留回放审计及其固定 SHA helper 的原相对布局。此处没有原始 profile、模型权重、上游源码树、二进制 SO、SSH transport、凭据或服务/SDK/controller 启动作业。

## 可直接执行的 CPU 核验

在本目录执行以下命令，输出目录必须不存在：

```bash
python3 check_cpu.py --output PRIVATE_PATH_9804bbe696a2
```

def join_marker(marker, nodes):
    q=marker['model_ri_query']

    assert annotation=={'q27_marker_id':marker['marker_id'],'q27_marker_schema':1}
    assert q['marker_id']==marker['marker_id']
    assert q['capture_id']==marker['capture_id']
    assert q['graph_python_id']==marker['graph_python_id']
    assert q['device_id']==marker['device']
    assert q['query_phase']=='post_capture_before_graph_reset'
    assert q['capture_status']==1 and q['model_ri_nonnull'] is True
    assert marker['callback_capture_status']==1 and marker['callback_nonnull'] is True
    for k in ['extend_info_rc','task_after_rc','model_ri_get_id_rc',
              'get_streams_rc','capture_rc','callback_rc']:
        assert q[k]==0,k
    assert all(v==0 for v in marker['callback_return_codes'].values())
    assert q['annotation_task_id_unchanged'] is True
    assert q['task_annotation_status']=='annotated_exact_last_task_candidate'
    assert q['task_id_before_annotation']==q['task_id_after_annotation']==marker['task_id']
    assert q['physical_stream_id']==marker['acl_stream_id']
    streams=q['model_streams']

    stream_ids={int(s['model_stream_id']) for s in streams}
    matches=[]
    for i,node in enumerate(nodes):
        args=node.get('args',{})
        ext=args.get('ExtendInfo')
        if isinstance(ext,str):
            try:ext=json.loads(ext)
            except (ValueError,TypeError):continue

            matches.append((i,node,ext))
    assert len(matches)==1,('raw_annotation_cardinality',len(matches))
    i,node,ext=matches[0];args=node['args']
    assert ext==annotation
    assert args['Task Type']=='EVENT_RECORD'
    assert node['pid']==str(marker['pid'])+' aclGraph'
    assert int(args['Model Id'])==q['model_ri_id']
    assert int(args['Task Id'])==marker['task_id']

from __future__ import annotations

import functools
import json
import os
import threading
import time
from typing import Any

_LOCK = threading.Lock()
_PATH = os.environ.get("Q27_FRONTEND_STAGE_JSONL")


def _event(name: str, **fields: Any) -> None:
    if not _PATH:
        return
    row = {
        "event": name,
        "pid": os.getpid(),
        "mono_ns": time.monotonic_ns(),
        "wall_ns": time.time_ns(),
        **fields,
    }
    try:
        payload = json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n"
        with _LOCK, open(_PATH, "a", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            stream.write(payload)
    except Exception:
        # Diagnostics must not alter serving behavior.
        return


def _install(cls: type, method_name: str, factory) -> bool:
    original = getattr(cls, method_name, None)
    if original is None or getattr(original, "_q27_frontend_stage", False):
        return False
    wrapped = factory(original)
    wrapped._q27_frontend_stage = True
    setattr(cls, method_name, wrapped)
    return True


def install_sgl(namespace: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    """Call after tokenizer_manager/http_server modules finish loading."""
    installed: list[str] = []
    manager = namespace.get("TokenizerManager")
    if not isinstance(manager, type):
        return installed

    def generate_factory(original):
        @functools.wraps(original)
        async def wrapped(self, obj, request=None, *args, **kwargs):
            rid = getattr(obj, "rid", None)
            headers = getattr(request, "headers", None)
            external = headers.get("x-request-id") if headers is not None else None
            _event("sg_http_request_enter", rid=rid, external_request_id=external,
                   request_type=type(obj).__name__)
            try:
                # TokenizerManager.generate_request is an async generator in
                # this source snapshot. Keep that protocol instead of awaiting
                # its returned generator or converting it to a coroutine.
                linked = False
                async for item in original(self, obj, request, *args, **kwargs):
                    if not linked:
                        rid = getattr(obj, "rid", None)
                        _event("sg_request_id_link", rid=rid,
                               external_request_id=external,
                               association="same normalized manager request at first yield")
                        linked = True
                    yield item
                _event("sg_http_request_end", rid=getattr(obj, "rid", rid),
                       external_request_id=external)
            except BaseException as exc:
                _event("sg_http_request_exception", rid=rid,
                       external_request_id=external, exception_type=type(exc).__name__)
                raise
        return wrapped

    if _install(manager, "generate_request", generate_factory):
        installed.append("TokenizerManager.generate_request")

    def tokenize_factory(original):
        @functools.wraps(original)
        async def wrapped(self, obj, *args, **kwargs):
            rid = getattr(obj, "rid", None)
            if getattr(obj, "input_embeds", None) is not None:
                path = "input_embeds"
            elif getattr(obj, "input_ids", None) is not None:
                path = "pretokenized_input_ids"
            else:
                path = "text_or_multimodal_processor"
            _event("sg_tokenize_begin", rid=rid, path=path)
            try:
                result = await original(self, obj, *args, **kwargs)
            except BaseException as exc:
                _event("sg_tokenize_exception", rid=rid, path=path,
                       exception_type=type(exc).__name__)
                raise
            _event("sg_tokenize_end", rid=rid, path=path,
                   input_id_count=(len(getattr(result, "input_ids", []))
                                   if getattr(result, "input_ids", None) is not None else None))
            return result
        return wrapped

    if _install(manager, "_tokenize_one_request", tokenize_factory):
        installed.append("TokenizerManager._tokenize_one_request")

    def dispatch_factory(original):
        @functools.wraps(original)
        def wrapped(self, obj, *args, **kwargs):
            rid = getattr(obj, "rid", None)
            _event("sg_enqueue_send_begin", rid=rid, transport="sync_sock_send")
            try:
                result = original(self, obj, *args, **kwargs)
            except BaseException as exc:
                _event("sg_enqueue_send_exception", rid=rid,
                       exception_type=type(exc).__name__)
                raise
            _event("sg_enqueue_send_end", rid=rid, transport="sync_sock_send")
            return result
        return wrapped

    if _install(manager, "_dispatch_to_scheduler", dispatch_factory):
        installed.append("TokenizerManager._dispatch_to_scheduler")
    return installed


def install_vllm(namespace: dict[str, Any], input_namespace: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
                 core_namespace: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> list[str]:
    """Call after async_llm, input_processor, and core_client modules load."""
    cls = namespace.get("AsyncLLM")
    if not isinstance(cls, type):
        return []
    installed: list[str] = []

    input_cls = (input_namespace or {}).get("InputProcessor")
    if isinstance(input_cls, type):
        proc = getattr(input_cls, "process_inputs", None)
        if proc is not None and not getattr(proc, "_q27_frontend_stage", False):
            @functools.wraps(proc)
            def process_wrapped(self, request_id, prompt, *args, **kwargs):
                path = ("already_rendered_engine_input"
                        if isinstance(prompt, dict) and "type" in prompt
                        else "raw_input_processing")
                _event("vllm_input_processing_begin", native_request_id=request_id,
                       prompt_type=type(prompt).__name__, path=path)
                try:
                    result = proc(self, request_id, prompt, *args, **kwargs)
                except BaseException as exc:
                    _event("vllm_input_processing_exception", native_request_id=request_id,
                           path=path, exception_type=type(exc).__name__)
                    raise
                _event("vllm_input_processing_end", native_request_id=request_id, path=path)
                return result
            process_wrapped._q27_frontend_stage = True
            setattr(input_cls, "process_inputs", process_wrapped)
            installed.append("InputProcessor.process_inputs")

    original = getattr(cls, "add_request", None)
    if original is None or getattr(original, "_q27_frontend_stage", False):
        return installed

    @functools.wraps(original)
    async def wrapped(self, request_id, prompt, *args, **kwargs):
        # Prompt is deliberately not inspected or serialized.
        _event("vllm_async_add_request_begin", native_request_id=request_id,
               prompt_type=type(prompt).__name__)
        try:
            result = await original(self, request_id, prompt, *args, **kwargs)
        except BaseException as exc:
            _event("vllm_async_add_request_exception", native_request_id=request_id,
                   exception_type=type(exc).__name__)
            raise
        _event("vllm_async_add_request_end", native_request_id=request_id)
        return result

    wrapped._q27_frontend_stage = True
    setattr(cls, "add_request", wrapped)
    installed.append("AsyncLLM.add_request")

    seen_classes: set[int] = set()
    for core_cls in (core_namespace or {}).values():
        if not isinstance(core_cls, type) or id(core_cls) in seen_classes:
            continue
        seen_classes.add(id(core_cls))
        core_method = core_cls.__dict__.get("add_request_async")
        if core_method is None or getattr(core_method, "_q27_frontend_stage", False):
            continue
        @functools.wraps(core_method)
        async def core_wrapped(self, request, *args, __original=core_method, **kwargs):
            rid = getattr(request, "request_id", None)
            _event("vllm_engine_core_enqueue_begin", native_request_id=rid,
                   client_type=type(self).__name__)
            try:
                result = await __original(self, request, *args, **kwargs)
            except BaseException as exc:
                _event("vllm_engine_core_enqueue_exception", native_request_id=rid,
                       client_type=type(self).__name__, exception_type=type(exc).__name__)
                raise
            _event("vllm_engine_core_enqueue_end", native_request_id=rid,
                   client_type=type(self).__name__)
            return result
        core_wrapped._q27_frontend_stage = True
        setattr(core_cls, "add_request_async", core_wrapped)
        installed.append(core_cls.__name__ + ".add_request_async")
    return installed

"""Opt-in post-capture raw NPUGraph dump observer.

Set Q27_NPUGRAPH_DUMP_DIR before process startup, then call install() after
torch_npu.npu.graphs is imported. This wraps the existing Python NPUGraph
capture_end method; it never creates, mutates, or replays a graph.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import functools
import json
import os
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path

_ENV = "Q27_NPUGRAPH_DUMP_DIR"
_LOCK = threading.Lock()
_COUNTER = 0
_INSTALLED = set()
_CAPTURE_CONTEXT = {}

def _next_seq():
    global _COUNTER
    with _LOCK:
        _COUNTER += 1
        return _COUNTER

def _atomic_json(path: Path, payload):
    tmp = path.with_name(path.name + f".tmp.{os.getpid()}.{threading.get_ident()}")
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    os.replace(tmp, path)

def install(npugraph_cls=None, dump_dir=None):
    """Install once; accepts a class for tests or imports torch_npu lazily.

    Returns a small status mapping. With no env override and no dump_dir, this
    is a no-op. Failures during dump are captured in receipts and do not change
    capture_end's successful return value. The original capture_end exception
    propagates unchanged and causes no dump attempt.
    """
    target = dump_dir if dump_dir is not None else os.environ.get(_ENV)
    if not target:
        return {"installed": False, "reason": f"set {_ENV} or pass dump_dir"}
    if npugraph_cls is None:
        from torch_npu.npu.graphs import NPUGraph as npugraph_cls
    key = (npugraph_cls, os.path.abspath(os.fspath(target)))
    if key in _INSTALLED:
        return {"installed": True, "already_installed": True, "dump_dir": key[1]}
    original = npugraph_cls.capture_end

    @functools.wraps(original)
    def capture_end_with_raw_dump(self, *args, **kwargs):
        seq = _next_seq()
        pid = os.getpid()
        graph_python_id = id(self)
        root = Path(key[1]) / f"pid-{pid}"
        stem = f"graph-{graph_python_id}-capture-{seq}"
        raw = root / "raw" / f"{stem}.json"
        derived = root / "derived" / f"{stem}.aligned.json"
        receipt = root / "receipts" / f"{stem}.receipt.json"
        rec = {
            "schema_version": 1, "pid": pid, "thread_id": threading.get_ident(),
            "graph_python_id": graph_python_id, "capture_sequence": seq,
            "raw_path": str(raw), "derived_path": str(derived),
            "derived_semantics": "visualization-only rebuilt/aligned timestamps; never measured timing",
            "started_unix_ns": time.time_ns(),
        }
        try:
            result = original(self, *args, **kwargs)
        except BaseException as exc:
            rec.update({"capture_end_status": "failure", "dump_status": "skipped_capture_end_failed",
                        "error_type": type(exc).__name__, "error": str(exc)[:1000]})
            rec["finished_unix_ns"] = time.time_ns()
            _CAPTURE_CONTEXT[graph_python_id]=dict(rec)
            try:
                receipt.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                _atomic_json(receipt, rec)
            except BaseException:
                pass
            raise
        rec.update({"capture_end_status": "success", "capture_end_return_type": type(result).__name__,
                    "capture_end_return_repr": repr(result)[:256]})
        try:
            raw.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            derived.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            receipt.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            dump_result = self.debug_dump(str(raw))
            runtime_aligned = raw.with_suffix(".aligned.json")
            if runtime_aligned.is_file():
                os.replace(runtime_aligned, derived)
            from torch import distributed as dist
            actual_rank=int(dist.get_rank()) if dist.is_initialized() else None
            graph_rows=json.loads(raw.read_text()) if raw.is_file() else []
            graph_nodes=graph_rows if isinstance(graph_rows,list) else graph_rows.get('traceEvents',[])
            models=set()
            for node in graph_nodes:
                if not isinstance(node,dict):continue
                for box in [node,node.get('args',{})]:
                    if not isinstance(box,dict):continue
                    for name,value in box.items():
                        if ''.join(c.lower()for c in str(name)if c.isalnum())=='modelid' and value is not None:models.add(str(value))
            rec['graph_model_ids']=sorted(models)
            rec.update(rank_id=actual_rank, rank_source='torch.distributed.get_rank' if actual_rank is not None else 'distributed_not_initialized',capture_id=os.environ.get('Q27_LINEAGE_GENERATION','initial'),generation=os.environ.get('Q27_LINEAGE_GENERATION','initial'),graph_node_pids=sorted({str(node['pid']) for node in graph_nodes if isinstance(node,dict) and node.get('pid') is not None}))
            rec.update({
                "dump_status": "success", "debug_dump_return_type": type(dump_result).__name__,
                "raw_exists": raw.is_file(), "raw_size_bytes": raw.stat().st_size if raw.is_file() else None,
                "derived_exists": derived.is_file(),
                "debug_dump_return_repr": repr(dump_result)[:256],
            })
        except Exception as exc:
            # Observer must not turn an already successful capture_end into a failure.
            rec.update({"dump_status": "failure", "error_type": type(exc).__name__, "error": str(exc)[:1000]})
        finally:
            rec["finished_unix_ns"] = time.time_ns()
            _CAPTURE_CONTEXT[graph_python_id]=dict(rec)
            try:
                receipt.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                _atomic_json(receipt, rec)
            except BaseException:
                # Keep observation strictly non-fatal, including receipt I/O.
                pass
        return result

    npugraph_cls.capture_end = capture_end_with_raw_dump
    def emit_replay(row):
        path=Path(key[1])/('pid-'+str(os.getpid()))/'replay-events.jsonl'
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        data=(json.dumps(row,separators=(',',':'))+'\n').encode()
        fd=os.open(path,os.O_CREAT|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND,0o600)
        try:os.write(fd,data)
        finally:os.close(fd)
    from q27_graph_replay_identity import install as observe_replay
    observe_replay(npugraph_cls,lambda graph:_CAPTURE_CONTEXT.get(id(graph)),emit_replay)
    _INSTALLED.add(key)
    return {"installed": True, "dump_dir": key[1], "target": f"{npugraph_cls.__module__}.{npugraph_cls.__qualname__}.capture_end"}

"""Opt-in root-owned vLLM full-model FX layer-event diagnostic glue.

No torch/NPU import at module import. Root supplies explicit drain/emit/device
providers and owns replay fences plus shutdown cleanup.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import functools
import hashlib
import importlib.abc
import importlib.machinery
import importlib.util
import itertools
import json
import os
import re
import sys
import threading
from pathlib import Path

from fx_layer_event_injector import insert_layer_endpoint_markers

COMPILER_TARGETS = {
    "npugraph_ex.npu_fx_compiler", "torch_npu.dynamo.npugraph_ex.npu_fx_compiler",
    "npugraph_ex._acl_concrete_graph.fx2acl_converter",
    "torch_npu.dynamo.npugraph_ex._acl_concrete_graph.fx2acl_converter",
}
ACL_TARGET = "vllm_ascend.compilation.acl_graph"
_NS = "q27_vllm_layer_diag"
_LOCK = threading.RLock()
_TLS = threading.local()
_INSTALLED = set()
_COUNTER = itertools.count(1)
_EVENTS = {}                 # tag -> strong torch.npu.Event reference
_EVENT_HISTORY = {}          # tag -> replaced compile/runtime Events, held to reset
_COMPILE_ROWS = []
_GRAPHS = {}                  # id(graph) -> graph-bound strong refs
_ANCHOR_EXTENSION = None
_EMIT = None
_DRAIN = None
_TARGET_MODE = None
_DEVICE = None
_INSTALL_CONFIG = None


def anchor_extension():
    """The single loaded gen53 extension, shared with root replay fences."""
    if _ANCHOR_EXTENSION is None:
        raise RuntimeError("anchor extension is not loaded")
    return _ANCHOR_EXTENSION


def load_anchor_extension(path, expected_sha256):
    """Verify/import the Py3.12 gen78 annotated RI bridge under its exact init name."""
    global _ANCHOR_EXTENSION
    p = Path(path)
    digest = hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if digest != expected_sha256:
        raise RuntimeError("anchor extension SHA mismatch")
    name = "q27_vllm_task_anchor_tag_root78"
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, str(p))
    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
        raise ImportError("could not load gen53 anchor extension")
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[name] = module
    try:
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    except BaseException:
        sys.modules.pop(name, None)
        raise
    _ANCHOR_EXTENSION = module
    return module


def _marker_records(rows, capture_id):
    return [r for r in rows if r.get("capture_id") == capture_id]


def _capture_wrapper(cls, *, target_mode, drain_callbacks, emit, device_provider=None):
    key = (cls, "__call__")
    if key in _INSTALLED or not callable(getattr(cls, "__call__", None)):
        return False
    original = cls.__call__
    @functools.wraps(original)
    def wrapped(self, *args, **kwargs):
        # Use the runtime's already-established forward context; no imports or
        # tensor inspection are done to classify the owner.
        from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
        fc = get_forward_context()
        bd = fc.batch_descriptor
        mode = fc.cudagraph_runtime_mode
        entries = getattr(self, "concrete_aclgraph_entries", None)
        entry_before = entries.get(bd) if isinstance(entries, dict) else None
        if (mode != target_mode or mode != getattr(self, "runtime_mode", None)
                or (entry_before is not None and entry_before.aclgraph is not None)):
            return original(self, *args, **kwargs)
        capture_id = f"pid{os.getpid()}-capture{next(_COUNTER)}"
        scope = {"capture_id": capture_id, "phase": "aclgraph_capture",
                 "capture_state": True, "rows": [], "batch_descriptor": bd,
                 "wrapper": self, "entry_before": entry_before}
        stack = list(getattr(_TLS, "capture_stack", []))
        _TLS.capture_stack = stack + [scope]
        try:
            result = original(self, *args, **kwargs)
        except BaseException:
            scope["status"] = "original_call_raised"
            _COMPILE_ROWS.append({"status": scope["status"], "capture_id": capture_id,
                                  "callback_rows": scope["rows"]})
            raise
        finally:
            _TLS.capture_stack = stack
        entries_after = getattr(self, "concrete_aclgraph_entries", None)
        entry = entries_after.get(bd) if isinstance(entries_after, dict) else None
        graph = getattr(entry, "aclgraph", None) if entry is not None else None
        if entry is None or graph is None or (entry_before is not None and entry is not entry_before):
            _COMPILE_ROWS.append({"status": "unknown_owner_or_graph_not_created",
                                  "capture_id": capture_id, "callback_rows": scope["rows"]})
            return result
        # Keep graph and all tag events alive before any callback extraction.
        rows = scope["rows"]
        tags = sorted({r.get("marker_id", "") + ":event" for r in rows
                       if isinstance(r.get("marker_id"), str)})
        observed_events = {r["marker_id"] + ":event": r["event_ref"] for r in rows
                           if isinstance(r.get("marker_id"), str) and r.get("event_ref") is not None}
        # On incomplete callback evidence retain all event refs until root has
        # exact ownership/reset proof; successful gates bind only this set.
        events = dict(observed_events) if len(observed_events) == 128 else dict(_EVENTS)
        event_tags = tuple(sorted(set(tags)))
        event_history = {tag: tuple(_EVENT_HISTORY.get(tag, ())) for tag in event_tags}
        record = {"graph": graph, "wrapper": self, "entry": entry,
                  "graph_key": bd, "device": device_provider(fc) if device_provider else None,
                  "events": events, "event_tags": event_tags,
                  "event_history": event_history, "capture_id": capture_id,
                  "callback_rows": rows}
        with _LOCK:
            _GRAPHS[id(graph)] = record
        try:
            # Supplied root callback performs its approved saved-stream/device
            # drain, then returns decoded rows; this wrapper does no sync itself.
            decoded = drain_callbacks(rows)
            if not isinstance(decoded, list):
                decoded = []
            valid, reason = _validate_capture_rows(decoded, capture_id)
            if valid and any((row["marker_id"] + ":event") not in events for row in decoded):
                valid, reason = False, "capture_event_ref_missing"
            # Callback drain is complete. Query borrowed RI handles now, while
            # this exact owner graph remains strongly held and before reset.
            ri_queries = (_query_capture_ri(_ANCHOR_EXTENSION, decoded,
                           capture_id=capture_id, graph=graph,
                           device_id=record["device"]) if valid else [])
            record["ri_queries"] = ri_queries
            by_marker = {q.get("marker_id"): q for q in ri_queries}
            status = "exact_capture_marker_set" if valid else "unknown_capture_marker_set"
            summary = {"status": status, "reason": reason, "capture_id": capture_id,
                       "graph_python_id": id(graph), "marker_count": len(decoded),
                       "expected_marker_count": 128,
                       "batch_descriptor": _safe_scalar(bd), "device": record["device"]}
            if valid:
                for row in decoded:
                    marker_id = row["marker_id"]
                    tag = marker_id + ":event"
                    layer_match = re.search(r":layer(\d+):(pre|post)$", marker_id)
                    safe_row = {k: v for k, v in row.items()
                                if k not in {"callback", "result", "event", "event_ref", "stream_ref"}}
                    emit("layer_public_event_marker", **{
                        "capture_invocation_id": capture_id, "capture_id": capture_id,
                        "graph_python_id": id(graph), "batch_descriptor": _safe_scalar(bd),
                        "device": record["device"], "event_ref_tag": tag,
                        "graph_identity_status": "unique_backend_saved_graph_object",
                        "classification": "capture_endpoint_candidate",
                        "producer_pid": os.getpid(),
                        "layer_idx": int(layer_match.group(1)) if layer_match else None,
                        "marker_side": layer_match.group(2) if layer_match else None,
                        "callback_nonnull": row.get("callback_nonnull"),
                        "callback_capture_status": row.get("callback_capture_status"),
                        "model_ri_query": by_marker.get(marker_id, {
                            "status": "unknown_query_missing_for_marker",
                            "marker_id": marker_id, "capture_id": capture_id,
                            "graph_python_id": id(graph), "device_id": record["device"]}),
                        **safe_row})
                if valid:
                    summary["status"] = "exact_capture_marker_set"
            summary.update({"capture_invocation_id": capture_id,
                            "marker_rows": len(decoded),
                            "capture_endpoint_rows": len(decoded) if valid else 0,
                            "ri_query_rows": len(ri_queries),
                            "ri_single_stream_candidate_rows": sum(
                                q.get("ri_bridge_status") == "candidate_singleton_pair_requires_same_profile_match"
                                for q in ri_queries),
                            "ri_queries_require_same_profile_match": True,
                            "graph_identity_status": "unique_backend_saved_graph_object"})
            emit("layer_public_event_summary", **summary)
            _COMPILE_ROWS.append(summary)
        except BaseException as exc:
            # Retain the graph/events on all post-capture failures.
            _COMPILE_ROWS.append({"status": "capture_rows_drain_or_emit_failed",
                                  "capture_id": capture_id, "graph_python_id": id(graph),
                                  "error_type": type(exc).__name__})
            raise
        return result
    wrapped._q27_vllm_fx_owner_wrapped = True
    cls.__call__ = wrapped
    _INSTALLED.add(key)
    return True


def _safe_scalar(value):
    if value is None or isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool)):
        return value
    return None


def _validate_capture_rows(rows, capture_id):
    if not isinstance(rows, list) or len(rows) != 128:
        return False, "callback_row_count_not_128"
    expected = {f"layer{i:02d}:{edge}" for i in range(64) for edge in ("pre", "post")}
    seen = set()
    for row in rows:
        if not isinstance(row, dict): return False, "callback_row_not_object"
        if row.get("capture_id") != capture_id: return False, "capture_id_mismatch"
        marker = row.get("marker_id")
        # Prefix includes PID/compile serial and is deliberately treated opaque.
        suffix = marker.rsplit(":", 2)[-2:] if isinstance(marker, str) else []
        if len(suffix) != 2 or suffix[0] not in {f"layer{i:02d}" for i in range(64)} or suffix[1] not in {"pre", "post"}:
            return False, "marker_identity_malformed"
        ident = ":".join(suffix)
        if ident not in expected or ident in seen: return False, "marker_missing_or_duplicate"
        if (row.get("callback_capture_status") != 1
                or row.get("callback_nonnull") is not True
                or ("model_ri_nonnull" in row and row.get("model_ri_nonnull") is not True)):
            return False, "callback_not_successful_capture"
        return_codes = row.get("callback_return_codes")
        expected_rcs = {"callback_rc", "capture_rc", "stream_rc", "task_rc"}
        if not isinstance(return_codes, dict) or set(return_codes) != expected_rcs or any(rc != 0 for rc in return_codes.values()):
            return False, "callback_api_return_codes_not_all_zero"
        if row.get("event_ref") is None or row.get("stream_ref") is None:
            return False, "event_or_capture_stream_reference_missing"
        seen.add(ident)
    return seen == expected, None if seen == expected else "marker_set_incomplete"


def _query_capture_ri(extension, rows, *, capture_id, graph, device_id):
    """Query each drained marker's exact callback result before graph reset.

    Full stream lists and API results are retained. Singleton rows are only
    candidates for validation against the same raw profile; ID domains are not
    assumed equivalent, and multi-stream rows remain ambiguous.
    """
    queries = []
    seen = set()
    for row in rows:
        marker = row.get("marker_id") if isinstance(row, dict) else None
        base = {"anchor_id": marker, "marker_id": marker,
                "capture_id": capture_id, "graph_python_id": id(graph),
                "device_id": device_id}
        if (not isinstance(marker, str) or not marker or marker in seen
                or row.get("capture_id") != capture_id):
            queries.append({**base, "status": "unknown_marker_identity_or_capture_mismatch"})
            continue
        seen.add(marker)
        anchor_result = row.get("callback")
        if anchor_result is None:
            queries.append({**base, "status": "unknown_callback_result_missing"})
            continue
        try:
            result = extension.query_model_ri(anchor_result)
            if not isinstance(result, dict):
                queries.append({**base, "status": "unknown_query_result_not_object"})
                continue
            query = {**base, **result}
            streams = query.get("model_streams")
            if (query.get("model_ri_get_id_rc") != 0
                    or query.get("get_streams_rc") != 0
                    or not isinstance(streams, list) or not streams
                    or any(s.get("stream_get_id_rc") != 0
                           or s.get("model_stream_id") is None for s in streams)):
                query["ri_bridge_status"] = "unknown_query_or_stream_list"
            elif len(streams) != 1:
                query["ri_bridge_status"] = "unknown_multiple_model_streams"
            elif query.get("physical_stream_id") is None:
                query["ri_bridge_status"] = "unknown_physical_stream_id"
            else:
                query["ri_bridge_status"] = "candidate_singleton_pair_requires_same_profile_match"
                query["model_stream_id_candidate"] = streams[0]["model_stream_id"]
                query["no_integer_domain_equivalence_assumed"] = True
            query["task_annotation_status"] = (
                "unknown_extend_info_rc_or_task_id_changed"
                if query.get("extend_info_rc") not in (None, 0)
                   or query.get("task_after_rc") not in (None, 0)
                   or query.get("annotation_task_id_unchanged") is False
                else ("annotated_exact_last_task_candidate"
                      if query.get("extend_info_rc") == 0
                         and query.get("annotation_task_id_unchanged") is True
                      else "not_requested_or_api_not_reported"))
            queries.append(query)
        except Exception as exc:
            queries.append({**base, "status": "unknown_ri_query_exception",
                            "error_type": type(exc).__name__})
    return queries


def _install_compiler(module, torch, create_event):
    name = getattr(module, "__name__", "")
    if name not in COMPILER_TARGETS: return []
    installed = []
    cls = getattr(module, "AclConcreteGraph", None)
    if cls is None or (cls, "save_fx_graph") in _INSTALLED: return installed
    original = getattr(cls, "save_fx_graph", None)
    if not callable(original): return installed
    @functools.wraps(original)
    def save_fx_graph(self, graph_module, *args, **kwargs):
        serial = next(_COUNTER)
        prefix = f"pid{os.getpid()}-compile{serial}"
        tagged_op = torch.ops.npugraph_ex.tagged_event_record.default
        anchor_op = torch.ops.q27_vllm_layer_diag.anchor.default
        result = insert_layer_endpoint_markers(self, graph_module, prefix=prefix,
                    create_event_by_name=create_event,
                    tagged_event_record_op=tagged_op, anchor_op=anchor_op)
        _COMPILE_ROWS.append({"status": result.get("status"), "phase": "save_fx_graph",
                              "pid": os.getpid(), "compile_serial": serial,
                              "graph_module_id": id(graph_module),
                              "marker_count": result.get("tagged_event_record_count", 0),
                              "reason": result.get("reason")})
        if result.get("status") == "unknown":
            raise RuntimeError("Q27 FX layer markers failed closed: " + str(result.get("reason")))
        return original(self, graph_module, *args, **kwargs)
    cls.save_fx_graph = save_fx_graph
    _INSTALLED.add((cls, "save_fx_graph"))
    installed.append(f"{name}.AclConcreteGraph.save_fx_graph")
    return installed


def _install_acl_graph(module, *, target_mode, drain_callbacks, emit, device_provider=None):
    if getattr(module, "__name__", None) != ACL_TARGET: return []
    cls = getattr(module, "ACLGraphWrapper", None)
    if cls is None: return []
    return ["ACLGraphWrapper.__call__"] if _capture_wrapper(
        cls, target_mode=target_mode, drain_callbacks=drain_callbacks,
        emit=emit, device_provider=device_provider) else []


def _anchor_impl(extension):
    def phase_provider():
        stack = getattr(_TLS, "capture_stack", [])
        if stack:
            scope = stack[-1]
            return {"phase": "aclgraph_capture", "capture_state": True,
                    "capture_id": scope["capture_id"], "rows": scope["rows"]}
        return {"phase": "outside_capture", "capture_state": False,
                "capture_id": None, "rows": None}
    def record_function(label):
        import torch
        return torch.profiler.record_function(label)
    def wrapped(enum, marker_id, annotation_json):
        context = phase_provider()
        if enum not in {"after_add", "after_mul"} or not isinstance(marker_id, str) or not marker_id:
            raise ValueError("invalid anchor enum or marker identity")
        if (not isinstance(annotation_json, str)
                or len(annotation_json.encode("utf-8")) > 4096
                or "q27_marker_id" not in annotation_json
                or marker_id not in annotation_json):
            raise ValueError("invalid precomputed task annotation JSON")
        with record_function(marker_id):
            # The JSON literal is prepared during FX insertion, before capture.
            result = extension.anchor(enum, annotation_json)
        torch = sys.modules.get("torch")
        npu = getattr(torch, "npu", None) if torch is not None else None
        current_stream = getattr(npu, "current_stream", None) if npu is not None else None
        stream_ref = current_stream() if callable(current_stream) else None
        tag = marker_id + ":event"
        graph_pass = sys.modules.get("npugraph_ex._acl_concrete_graph.graph_pass")
        registry = getattr(graph_pass, "_GLOBAL_SCOPE_TAG_TO_EVENT", None)
        event_ref = registry.get(tag) if isinstance(registry, dict) else None
        if event_ref is not None:
            with _LOCK:
                history = _EVENT_HISTORY.setdefault(tag, [])
                if not any(ref is event_ref for ref in history):
                    history.append(event_ref)
                _EVENTS[tag] = event_ref
        row = {"marker_id": marker_id, "capture_id": context["capture_id"],
               "capture_scope_active": bool(context["capture_state"]),
               "callback": result, "event_ref": event_ref,
               "stream_ref": stream_ref}
        if context["rows"] is None:
            _COMPILE_ROWS.append({"status": "outside_capture_anchor_unknown",
                                  "marker_id": marker_id, "callback": result})
        else:
            context["rows"].append(row)
        return None
    return wrapped


def register_anchor_ops(torch, extension):
    """Register event op (installed package) and custom side-effect anchor."""
    importlib.import_module("npugraph_ex.ops._tagged_event")
    library = torch.library.Library(_NS, "DEF")
    library.define("anchor(str anchor_enum, str marker_id, str annotation_json) -> ()")
    op = getattr(getattr(torch.ops, _NS), "anchor").default
    from torch.fx.node import has_side_effect
    has_side_effect(op)
    library.impl("anchor", _anchor_impl(extension), "CompositeExplicitAutograd")
    library.impl("anchor", lambda enum, marker_id, annotation_json: None, "Meta")
    return library, op


def held_graphs():
    """Return graph-bound strong refs for root-owned fences/cleanup."""
    with _LOCK:
        return [dict(row) for row in _GRAPHS.values()]


def drain_captured_rows(graph):
    """Return retained raw callbacks for exact graph; caller decides when drained."""
    with _LOCK:
        row = _GRAPHS.get(id(graph))
        if row is None or row["graph"] is not graph:
            raise KeyError("graph is not held by this diagnostic")
        return list(row["callback_rows"])


def release_graph_after_reset(graph, receipt):
    """Release only after caller proves same graph reset/discard and device drains."""
    required = (isinstance(receipt, dict)
                and receipt.get("graph_python_id") == id(graph)
                and receipt.get("reset_or_discarded") is True
                and receipt.get("device_drained_before_and_after_reset") is True)
    if not required:
        return {"released": False, "reason": "reset_receipt_not_proven"}
    with _LOCK:
        row = _GRAPHS.get(id(graph))
        if row is None or row["graph"] is not graph:
            return {"released": False, "reason": "exact_graph_not_held"}
        graph_pass = sys.modules.get("npugraph_ex._acl_concrete_graph.graph_pass")
        registry = getattr(graph_pass, "_GLOBAL_SCOPE_TAG_TO_EVENT", None)
        for tag in row.get("event_tags", ()):
            _EVENTS.pop(tag, None)
            _EVENT_HISTORY.pop(tag, None)
            if isinstance(registry, dict):
                registry.pop(tag, None)
        _GRAPHS.pop(id(graph), None)
    return {"released": True, "graph_python_id": id(graph), "event_count": len(row["events"])}


def install(torch, extension, *, target_mode, drain_callbacks, emit,
            device_provider=None, module_names=()):
    """Install after ops registration; root retains returned library object."""
    global _ANCHOR_EXTENSION, _EMIT, _DRAIN, _TARGET_MODE, _DEVICE, _INSTALL_CONFIG
    _ANCHOR_EXTENSION, _EMIT, _DRAIN, _TARGET_MODE, _DEVICE = extension, emit, drain_callbacks, target_mode, device_provider
    library, anchor_op = register_anchor_ops(torch, extension)
    def create_event(tag):
        graph_pass = importlib.import_module("npugraph_ex._acl_concrete_graph.graph_pass")
        graph_pass._create_event_by_name(tag)
        event = graph_pass._GLOBAL_SCOPE_TAG_TO_EVENT.get(tag)
        if event is None:
            raise RuntimeError("tagged event registry did not retain created event")
        _EVENTS[tag] = event
        _EVENT_HISTORY.setdefault(tag, []).append(event)
        return event
    _INSTALL_CONFIG = {"torch": torch, "extension": extension,
                       "create_event": create_event, "target_mode": target_mode,
                       "drain_callbacks": drain_callbacks, "emit": emit,
                       "device_provider": device_provider}
    targets = set(COMPILER_TARGETS) | {ACL_TARGET}
    class Finder(importlib.abc.MetaPathFinder):
        def find_spec(self, fullname, path=None, target=None):
            if fullname not in targets: return None
            spec = importlib.machinery.PathFinder.find_spec(fullname, path)
            if spec and spec.loader and not isinstance(spec.loader, Loader): spec.loader = Loader(spec.loader)
            return spec
    class Loader(importlib.abc.Loader):
        def __init__(self, wrapped): self.wrapped = wrapped
        def create_module(self, spec):
            fn = getattr(self.wrapped, "create_module", None)
            return fn(spec) if fn else None
        def exec_module(self, module):
            self.wrapped.exec_module(module)
            install_module(module)
    if not any(type(item).__name__ == "Finder" and getattr(item, "_q27_vllm_events", False) for item in sys.meta_path):
        finder = Finder(); finder._q27_vllm_events = True
        sys.meta_path.insert(0, finder)
    installed = []
    for name in targets | set(module_names):
        module = sys.modules.get(name)
        if module is not None: installed.extend(install_module(module))
    return {"library": library, "anchor_op": anchor_op, "installed": installed,
            "anchor_extension": extension}


def register_import_finder(torch, extension, *, target_mode, drain_callbacks, emit,
                           device_provider=None, module_names=()):
    """Root bootstrap entry; call before target imports with explicit runtime providers."""
    return install(torch, extension, target_mode=target_mode,
                   drain_callbacks=drain_callbacks, emit=emit,
                   device_provider=device_provider, module_names=module_names)


def install_module(module):
    """Patch a just-loaded or already-loaded target module; root may wrap this."""
    config = _INSTALL_CONFIG
    if config is None:
        return []
    name = getattr(module, "__name__", "")
    if name in COMPILER_TARGETS:
        return _install_compiler(module, config["torch"], config["create_event"])
    if name == ACL_TARGET:
        return _install_acl_graph(module, target_mode=config["target_mode"],
                  drain_callbacks=config["drain_callbacks"], emit=config["emit"],
                  device_provider=config["device_provider"])
    return []

import types
import unittest
from types import SimpleNamespace

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
import q27_vllm_fx_events as q
from fx_layer_event_injector import build_task_annotation


class RIQueryOrderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        q._GRAPHS.clear(); q._EVENTS.clear(); q._EVENT_HISTORY.clear()
        q._COMPILE_ROWS.clear(); q._TLS.capture_stack = []
        self.events = []
        self.extension = SimpleNamespace(query_model_ri=self.query)
        q._ANCHOR_EXTENSION = self.extension

    def test_annotation_is_precomputed_ascii_json_bounded_and_exact(self):
        marker="pid17-compile2:layer03:post"
        encoded=build_task_annotation(marker)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(encoded),{"q27_marker_id":marker,"q27_marker_schema":1})
        self.assertTrue(encoded.isascii())
        self.assertLessEqual(len(encoded.encode("utf-8")),4096)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): build_task_annotation("")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): build_task_annotation("标签")

    def query(self, result):
        self.events.append(("query", result))
        return result

    def test_callback_queries_follow_drain_and_bind_marker_graph_device(self):
        graph = object(); entry = SimpleNamespace(aclgraph=None)
        fc = SimpleNamespace(batch_descriptor="bd", cudagraph_runtime_mode="target")
        sys.modules["vllm.forward_context"] = SimpleNamespace(get_forward_context=lambda: fc)
        sys.modules["vllm"] = types.ModuleType("vllm")
        events = self.events
        rows = []
        class Wrapper:
            runtime_mode = "target"
            concrete_aclgraph_entries = {"bd": entry}
            def __call__(self):
                self.concrete_aclgraph_entries["bd"].aclgraph = graph
                scope = q._TLS.capture_stack[-1]
                for i in range(64):
                    for side in ("pre", "post"):
                        marker = f"pid{os.getpid()}-compile1:layer{i:02d}:{side}"
                        result = {"model_ri_get_id_rc": 0, "get_streams_rc": 0,
                            "model_ri_id": 48, "model_ri_handle_token": "ri",
                            "physical_stream_id": 45,
                            "model_streams": [{"stream_get_id_rc": 0,"model_stream_id": 12}]}
                        scope["rows"].append({"marker_id": marker,"capture_id":scope["capture_id"],
                            "callback_capture_status":1,"callback_nonnull":True,
                            "model_ri_nonnull":True,"callback_return_codes":{
                                "callback_rc":0,"capture_rc":0,"stream_rc":0,"task_rc":0},
                            "event_ref":object(),"stream_ref":object(),"callback":result})
                return "output"
        def drain(raw):
            events.append(("drain", len(raw)))
            return raw
        emitted=[]
        def emit(name, **kwargs):
            events.append(("emit", name))
            emitted.append((name, kwargs))
        q._capture_wrapper(Wrapper, target_mode="target", drain_callbacks=drain, emit=emit,
                           device_provider=lambda _fc: "device-0")
        self.assertEqual(Wrapper()(), "output")
        drain_at = next(i for i, e in enumerate(events) if e[0] == "drain")
        first_query_at = next(i for i, e in enumerate(events) if e[0] == "query")
        first_emit_at = next(i for i, e in enumerate(events) if e[0] == "emit")
        self.assertLess(drain_at, first_query_at)
        self.assertLess(first_query_at, first_emit_at)
        self.assertEqual(sum(e[0] == "query" for e in events), 128)
        markers=[k for n,k in emitted if n == "layer_public_event_marker"]
        self.assertEqual(len(markers),128)
        first=markers[0]["model_ri_query"]
        self.assertEqual(first["marker_id"],markers[0]["marker_id"])
        self.assertEqual(first["graph_python_id"],id(graph))
        self.assertEqual(first["capture_id"],markers[0]["capture_id"])
        self.assertEqual(first["device_id"],"device-0")
        self.assertEqual(first["ri_bridge_status"],"candidate_singleton_pair_requires_same_profile_match")
        self.assertEqual(first["model_streams"],[{"stream_get_id_rc":0,"model_stream_id":12}])
        self.assertEqual(len(q.held_graphs()[0]["ri_queries"]),128)

    def test_multistream_is_preserved_but_never_mapped(self):
        graph=object(); result={"model_ri_get_id_rc":0,"get_streams_rc":0,
          "physical_stream_id":45,"model_ri_id":48,
          "model_streams":[{"stream_get_id_rc":0,"model_stream_id":12},
                            {"stream_get_id_rc":0,"model_stream_id":13}]}
        rows=[{"marker_id":"m0","capture_id":"c0","callback":result}]
        out=q._query_capture_ri(self.extension,rows,capture_id="c0",graph=graph,device_id=0)
        self.assertEqual(out[0]["ri_bridge_status"],"unknown_multiple_model_streams")
        self.assertEqual([x["model_stream_id"] for x in out[0]["model_streams"]],[12,13])
        self.assertNotIn("model_stream_id_candidate",out[0])

    def test_query_error_stays_unknown_and_does_not_drop_raw_callback(self):
        class Broken:
            def query_model_ri(self, _): raise RuntimeError("query failed")
        row={"marker_id":"m0","capture_id":"c0","callback":object(),"callback_capture_status":1}
        out=q._query_capture_ri(Broken(),[row],capture_id="c0",graph=object(),device_id=0)
        self.assertEqual(out[0]["status"],"unknown_ri_query_exception")
        self.assertEqual(out[0]["error_type"],"RuntimeError")
        self.assertEqual(row["callback_capture_status"],1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

# SGLang gen67 公共 Event 诊断组件

本包保留实际 gen67 的最小诊断源码子集及 SHA 绑定，提供 CPU 检查、raw/native 身份审计和历史扩展构建入口。它用于解释已采集的短诊断，不是推理优化或完整服务部署包。实际环境为 aarch64、910B1、TP4、CANN9.0.0、torch2.10.0+cpu、torch_npu2.10.0/git94f8a8e6；完整镜像、权重、输入和原始 profiling 另有证据入口。跨 CANN/卡组对照不能归因于单一框架。

`source-bindings.json` 逐件绑定任务内原件、复制件与 SHA。10 个运行模块与实际 gen67 部署清单逐件相等；动态加载的 `sg_layer_event_anchor.py` 也在其中。静态依赖扫描包括条件分支，不能证明实际命中。旧的非公共 Event 模式需要的 `sg_layer_task_anchor.py` 不在包中，只描述 `Q27_SG_LAYER_PUBLIC_EVENTS=1` 路径。`bootstrap-reference/sitecustomize.py` 仅供查阅原启动逻辑，单独放在不自动导入的目录。它引用的完整兼容 overlay、权重 gate、其他 profiler hooks 不在最小包内；不要将该目录直接加到服务 PYTHONPATH。兼容模块清单仅在 `deployment/sglang-manifest.json` 保留。

清理只有在外部 controller 确认最后请求 EOF 与 idle 后，才写入带任务 ID 和确切 worker PID 的独立 `Q27_EVENT_CLEANUP_REQUEST`。运行模块检查这个请求身份后 shutdown update executor、drain device/outer events、reset 确切 graph、再次 drain、删除 graph/output 引用并释放 Event，最后记录不可继续服务。模块自身不证明 EOF/idle，也不授予写清理请求的权限；实际控制仍需原 performance 锁和精确归属验证。失败保留引用和 unknown，不能写成清理完成。

EXPECTED_CPP_SHA256 = "0ef2e5b45078035326681c40e8bf15c742fe032b98ab38c367738fbc919c308a"
